rules.selector: body :is(.primary,.secondary,.chip,.ref-button,.suggestions button,.tabs button,.study-actions button,.card-bottom button,.results-line button)

rules.css: border:2px solid var(--tone-bright)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.15),0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tone-start) 18%,transparent),0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tone-end) 30%,transparent)

background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--tone-start,#475569),var(--tone-fade,#334155));color:var(--tone-ink,#fff);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tone-bright,#94a3b8) 65%,transparent);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tone-end,#334155) 17%,transparent);padding:14px 16px

background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%,rgba(59,130,246,.25),rgba(15,23,34,.7));background-color:#0f1722;border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.5);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(59,130,246,.25),inset 0 1px 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.45),inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);color:var(--control-text)

rules.selector: body a,body a:hover,body a:focus-visible,body.dark .comparison-sources a,body.dark .field-sources a,body .context-pointer a,body .citations-disclosure>summary

rules.css: min-width:0;padding:20px;border:1px solid rgba(var(--theme-rgb),.35);border-radius:22px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top left,rgba(var(--theme-rgb),.18),transparent 75%),rgba(var(--theme-rgb),.08);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(var(--theme-rgb),.12),0 0 18px rgba(var(--theme-rgb),.12),inset 0 1px 1px #ffffff60;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);overflow-wrap:anywhere

pointer-events: visiblePainted; /* IE 9-10 doesn't have auto */
	pointer-events: auto;

font: bold 18px 'Lucida Console', Monaco, monospace;
	text-indent: 1px;

/* used only in path-guessing heuristic, see L.Icon.Default */
	background-image: url(images/marker-icon.png);
